prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: TALKPIK AI auth error rate-limited state redesign concept
Input image role: source screenshot is a reference for rate-limited state and public recovery flow, not an edit target.
Primary request: Redesign 33-X-11-auth-error/rate-limited.
Direction: rate-limit countdown recovery.
Composition/framing: desktop 1280x900 edge-to-edge app UI screenshot only; no browser address bar, tabs, bookmarks bar, OS window title bar, device frame, or watermark. Preserve rate-limited auth error state: centered public error card, calm message that requests are temporarily limited, retry countdown or retry-after display, disabled primary retry button until timer ends, secondary login/home link, and no raw technical details.
Style/medium: high-fidelity Ant Design Result/Card/Statistic/Button UI, calm auth recovery page.
Color palette: Mist canvas, Snow card, Fog status strip, Ink text, Steel helper text, Obsidian CTA only when enabled.
Typography: Cosmica-like single sans, compact and clear, no letter spacing.
Constraints: wording must be safe and non-accusatory; no provider code or raw query values; Korean UI text is visual direction only and not final copy source.
Avoid: browser chrome, OS frame, device frame, red-dominant alarm treatment, AI gradients, colorful CTA, raw Supabase error text, exposed retry_after implementation detail beyond user countdown, watermark.
